name: Undo over confirm
rule: Let people reverse recoverable actions with undo; interrupt with a confirmation only for what cannot come back.

leaders.note: Deleting an issue needs no prompt. Undo restores it right away, and deleted items stay restorable from archives for roughly a month.
After a delete, a brief snackbar confirms the action and offers Undo, so the flow is never blocked by a dialog.
The blocking danger modal is kept for destructive or irreversible actions where a slip would cause serious data loss.
